message.content:
This is an autonomous mobile robot (AMR) for moving pallets and materials, which is a self-propelled vehicle for carrying loads in a factory or warehouse. Heading 8427 covers fork-lift trucks and other works trucks fitted with lifting or handling equipment. Heading 8709 covers works trucks, self-propelled, not fitted with lifting or handling equipment, of the type used in factories, warehouses, and similar settings for short-distance transport of goods. The P2200 is a base platform with no lifting equipment, so 8709 fits.

Within 8709, 8709.11 covers electrical works trucks and 8709.19 covers other. The P2200 is presumably battery-electric, so it goes under 8709.11. The statistical suffix for 8709.11.00 is 8709.11.0000. CBP rulings on similar Canadian AMRs (such as the OTTO) have classified them in 8709.11.0000.
